meta.title: Using postfix snippets on expressions containing `'\\'` results in it getting unescaped
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#12646 (fix: escape receiver texts in completion)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2022-07-18 and 2022-07-25; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2022-07-25. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1). A 2022 build parses the std sources of rustc 1.98.1 for the sysroot; the case needs only the postfix completion on a char literal.
meta.notes: Postfix completions put the receiver's text into a snippet without escaping the snippet metacharacters (\, $, }), so a snippet engine turns the receiver '\\' into '\'. The harness strips snippets with the LSP snippet rules (a backslash escapes $, } and \), as an editor does.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: verbatim (two-space indent) with the cursor marker '|' removed
a binary crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: Open src/main.rs. Request completion at the end of '\\'.ok (line 1, character 17, the issue's cursor '|') and accept the postfix item ok. Reported: Ok('\'), which is invalid syntax; expected Ok('\\'). Probe: the edited text must have no parse error that the original did not have.
